toegepas.voor: op sy plaas maar hy maak
toegepas.na: op sy plaas, maar hy maak
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'maar' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma is needed.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'maar' joining two clauses, each with its own subject and verb (''n Boer plant' / 'hy maak').
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain AWS 2017 punctuation fix that leaves the meaning unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two full sentences with their own subjects and verbs ('Die boer het ...' and 'die soutmaker ... het sout'), so a comma is needed.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full sentences ('Die boer het ...' / 'die soutmaker ... het sout').
toegepas.rede_keurder: A required AWS comma that sits next to the protected wording 'die soutmaker by die soutpan' and leaves it intact.

toegepas.voor: sy mielies na die soutmaker en kry
toegepas.na: sy mielies na die soutmaker toe en kry
toegepas.rede_vinder: Movement towards a person is idiomatically 'na ... toe' in Afrikaans.
toegepas.fout: 'neem ... na die soutmaker' without 'toe' reads stiff for movement towards a person.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'na die soutmaker toe' is the natural Afrikaans for movement towards someone, and the boer still takes the maize to the soutmaker.

toegepas.rede_vinder: With both the boer and the soutmaker in view, 'hy' is ambiguous; naming the soutmaker makes the reference clear.
toegepas.fout: 'hy' follows a sentence that names both the soutmaker and the boer, and the boer was named last, so a reader may stumble over who 'hy' is.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the soutmaker makes the reference clear without changing who wants what.

toegepas.voor: Geld beteken die koper en die verkoper hoef
toegepas.na: Met geld hoef die koper en die verkoper
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Geld beteken die koper ... hoef' copies English 'money means that ...'; 'Met geld hoef ...' is natural Afrikaans with the same meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'Geld beteken die koper ... hoef' copies English 'money means (that)' and reads wooden, with 'dat' missing.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Met geld hoef ...' is natural Afrikaans and says the same thing.

toegepas.voor: Hy kan die geld ook hou
toegepas.na: Die boer kan die geld ook hou
toegepas.rede_vinder: The previous sentence speaks generally ('die mense rondom jou'), so 'Hy' no longer clearly points back to the boer.
toegepas.fout: 'Hy' comes after a general sentence about 'die mense rondom jou', so it no longer clearly points back to the boer.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the boer again restores a clear reference and leaves the protected sentence before it intact.

laat_vaar.voor: op dieselfde dag dat die boer
laat_vaar.na: op dieselfde dag wanneer die boer
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'dieselfde dag dat' copies English 'the same day that'; Afrikaans uses a time relative ('wanneer') here.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'die dag dat' is established Afrikaans, not an anglicism, so swapping in 'wanneer' is a lateral move.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: diens - 'n Diens is werk wat iemand vir 'n ander doen, sodat die ander die werk self kry en nie 'n ding wat hy of sy kan hou nie.
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The second half reads awkwardly for Grade 6 ('die werk self kry en nie 'n ding ... nie' is a loose, elliptical construction). Not changed because it is a decided shared definition; a person may want to look at the wording across the subject.
